snippet.title: Hereditas – Official Trailer | Medieval Castle-Building Strategy
snippet.description:
Found your house. Raise your castle. Claim the crown.

Hereditas is a single-player medieval strategy game about building castles, leading a noble house and fighting for the crown. Design your own coat of arms, play the classic realm or a randomly generated world, and raise your castle stone by stone – from a wooden palisade on an empty hill to a mighty fortress.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1044700/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
▶ Sign up for the Closed Beta: https://forestergames.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer#beta
▶ Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/ZpAqpuM

FEATURES
• Found your house – design your own coat of arms; your colours appear on banners and soldiers
• Shape your world – play the classic realm or an endless number of randomly generated worlds
• Raise your castle – draw free-form walls, shape the terrain and upgrade from palisade to fortress
• A realm that lives without you – rival houses expand, forge alliances and go to war
• Seasons and weather – summer, autumn, winter and snowstorms change the land
• Lead your house – march your armies under your own banners

Coming 2027 · Windows · English & German
In-engine footage. Music: original Hereditas soundtrack by Tim Pielka.

#Hereditas #MedievalStrategy #CastleBuilding #IndieGame #GameTrailer
